# happel.ai – Luca Leon Happel

> Luca Leon Happel (M.Sc., B.Sc., B.Sc.) is a mathematician, computer scientist and security researcher based in Düsseldorf, Germany. He and his team build, audit and hack high-security systems in regulated industries, where mistakes are expensive: data science, AI, high-security audits, penetration testing, reverse engineering and app development. They work for any organisation where software must be secure and correct, from start-ups to enterprises and the public sector, including hospitals, medical-device makers, critical-infrastructure (KRITIS) operators, industry, finance and software vendors, across Germany and Europe, remote or on-site.

Key facts:

- Co-developed monti, an AI-based clinical patient-monitoring platform at University Hospital Düsseldorf, published in European Heart Journal – Digital Health (DOI 10.1093/ehjdh/ztaf004, 2025).
- Found and responsibly disclosed a high-severity vulnerability in mission-critical software used in highest-tier security environments (acknowledged by the vendor, March 2026).
- Has built MDR-compliant medical software since 2022.
- Degrees: M.Sc. Mathematics, B.Sc. Mathematics, B.Sc. Computer Science. Also offers tutoring (Nachhilfe) in mathematics and computer science for pupils (Gymnasium, vocational school, Abitur preparation) and university students (linear algebra, analysis, algebra, algebraic geometry, topology, type theory, probability theory, operating systems, functional & logic programming, machine learning), from exam crash courses to long-term preparation.
- Develops embedded firmware in Rust and C/C++ (e.g. ESP32); built a Corne keyboard with two PSP joysticks and wrote its Rust/RMK firmware from scratch. Uses formal verification (Lean 4) to make critical components provably correct.
- 2× 1st place HHU Ideenwettbewerb; festival award.
- Works with regulatory frameworks such as MDR, IEC 62443, NIS2 and FDA cybersecurity guidance; deploys on-premises RAG/LLM systems so sensitive data never leaves the client network.
- Contact: consulting@happel.ai (PGP 0x75A3FE23C6311437). Free 30-minute intro call, fixed-price written proposal, NDA on request. English and German.

## Services

- [Shop (English)](https://happel.ai/shop/): security audits & penetration testing, on-site security (data center assessments, on-premises AI server setup, physical and internal-network pentests, hospital network assessments), reverse engineering & vulnerability research, data science & on-premises AI, embedded & app development, tutoring in mathematics & computer science, FAQ and process
- [Shop (Deutsch)](https://happel.ai/de/shop/): the same in German

## Tutoring (Nachhilfe)

- [Tutoring in mathematics & computer science](https://happel.ai/shop/#cat-tutoring) / [Nachhilfe Mathematik & Informatik](https://happel.ai/de/shop/#cat-tutoring): by Luca Leon Happel (M.Sc. Mathematics, B.Sc. Mathematics, B.Sc. Computer Science). University level: linear algebra, analysis, algebra (groups, rings, fields, modules), algebraic geometry, topology and algebraic topology, type theory and category theory, probability theory, operating systems, functional & logic programming, machine learning. School level: Gymnasium, vocational school, Abitur preparation. Exam crash courses or long-term preparation. English and German.
